origin.description: Joins the elements of one character vector into one string.
origin.usage: stri_flatten(str, collapse = "", na_empty = FALSE, omit_empty = FALSE)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A vector of strings, coerced to character.

arguments.name: collapse
arguments.text: A single string placed between elements. Only the first element is used.

arguments.name: na_empty
arguments.text: TRUE treats a missing value as an empty string. NA drops missing values. FALSE makes the result missing.

arguments.name: omit_empty
arguments.text: If TRUE, empty strings are dropped.

origin.details: An empty vector becomes one empty string. A missing collapse makes the result missing. An empty collapse ignores omit_empty. With na_empty TRUE, a missing element still occupies a slot, so the separators around it remain unless omit_empty drops it.
origin.value: One string, returned as a character vector of length one.
origin.example: stri_flatten(c(NA, "", "A", "", "B", NA, "C"), collapse = ",", na_empty = TRUE, omit_empty = TRUE)

translation.description: Joins one vector into a single string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, None, or a list or tuple of strings, numbers, and missing values. None is an empty vector.

arguments.name: collapse
arguments.text: Separator between elements. Only the first element of a list is used. NA makes the result missing.

arguments.name: na_empty
arguments.text: True treats a missing value as an empty string. NA drops missing values. False makes the result missing.

arguments.name: omit_empty
arguments.text: If true, empty strings are dropped. A missing value is not allowed.

translation.details: An empty vector becomes one empty string. An empty collapse ignores omit_empty. With na_empty true, a missing element still holds a place between separators unless omit_empty drops it.
translation.value: A one-element list. The element is a string, or NA when the result is missing.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringi.join import stri_flatten
print(stri_flatten([NA, "", "A", "", "B", NA, "C"], collapse=",", na_empty=True, omit_empty=True))
